name: Opt-in GPU Sampling for tifxyz Rendering
definition: A technique to accelerate the sampling step of tifxyz surface rendering by offloading trilinear sampling and pyramid generation to a CUDA or ROCm GPU, while maintaining byte-identical output to the CPU reference implementation.
summary: Opt-in GPU Sampling for tifxyz Rendering accelerates volume rendering by offloading sampling to a GPU via LD_PRELOAD interposition, ensuring byte-identical output without modifying the existing C++ renderer.
